subject: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-103.draft.md
summary: Independent attack found no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX. All five measured inputs reproduce. Both independent contract reviews are ACCEPT with empty blocker and SHOULD-FIX arrays, and the draft accurately carries all three advisories without promoting or erasing them. The recording keeps DR-111 OPEN, reserves numeric windows, leaves S-EVIDENCE deferred with DR-113, produces no lock, does not invoke D-056 Class A, performs no MF-6/file-08 edit, grants no D-096(A) authority, and authorizes no implementation.

attack_results.attack: Silent SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, blueprint, or implementation authorization
attack_results.evidence: Decision item 3 says DR-111 stays OPEN and 'No SATISFIED' (lines 33-36). Item 4 denies blueprint and docs/v2/implementation authorization (lines 37-38). The SATISFIED and application alternatives are expressly rejected (lines 45-47), and readiness gains zero (line 51). Nothing claims QUALIFIED.

attack_results.attack: Treats advisories as blockers or pretends they do not exist
attack_results.evidence: Decision item 2 names Claude ADV-1/ADV-2 and Codex CMCV5-A1, says they are non-blocking, and carries them as successor honesty work (lines 30-32). The alternative at lines 43-44 states the governing 0-blocker/0-SHOULD-FIX gate and that advisories travel. This matches both live verdicts.

attack_results.attack: Claims a lock is now producible
attack_results.evidence: Decision item 3 expressly says no lock becomes producible (lines 33-36). The measured contract remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, reserves numeric windows, and says no lock of any form is producible until DR-111 closes with evaluable windows and a later DR-103 successor consumes them.

attack_results.attack: Opens D-056 Class A or SATISFIED while design leftovers remain
attack_results.evidence: Lines 33-36 keep numeric windows RESERVED and S-EVIDENCE deferred with DR-113, then expressly say D-056 Class A is not opened because the remainder is not only execution/measurement. Lines 45-46 reject SATISFIED on the same basis. Live D-056 requires a measurement/execution-only remainder, a dedicated later SATISFIED-grade review, and an MF-6 SATISFIED write; this draft performs none.

attack_results.attack: Edits file 08 without a separate MF-6 act
attack_results.evidence: Decision item 4 expressly says it does not edit file 08 (line 37). File 08 remained at the cited digest and its DR-111 row remains OPEN / Hard blocker. The draft records a coordinator decision only; it makes no register-content motion.

The cited precedents support the invoked form: D-013 and D-015 record independently accepted design contracts while leaving their rows OPEN and adding zero SATISFIED; D-035 records an ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES contract, keeps DR-114 OPEN, treats advisories as non-blockers, and makes no SATISFIED/freeze motion; D-042 records an accepted design-contract candidate, keeps DR-105 OPEN, carries advisories, edits neither file 08 nor the freeze, and adds zero SATISFIED. D-103 states the same bounded effect.
